cask: 62% refill sherry butts & 38% refill bourbon hogsheads
identity_note: ORCHESTRATOR SLUG CAVEAT: this node uses the assigned slug 'rosebank-31-r1', but Rosebank's Legacy Release One is a 30 YEAR OLD (1990, bottled 2020, 48.6% ABV), NOT a 31 Year Old. The 31 Year Old is Release Two (rosebank-31-r2). age_years and abv here reflect the true Release One bottle.

tasting.nose: Buttery and golden: rich vanilla, lemon meringue pie, honeycomb, polished oak, marzipan and a pinch of wood spice; vibrant citrus with orange zest, watermelon, apple skin, peach and nectarine; Chantilly cream and caramel wafers.
tasting.palate: Creamy, buttery and fruity with a gentle spiciness; sweet almonds, butterscotch, grapefruit peel, gooseberry, chamomile, pears and pineapple.
tasting.finish: Soft and intimate, with pear and vanilla; background wood spice.
tasting.narrative: A classic Rosebank and a fitting first chapter for the reborn distillery: delicate, spirit-driven and unmistakably Lowland. Critics were captivated (Connosr's note that 'the nose is just out of this world'), and Whisky Advocate's 92 points confirms the pedigree. A soft, elegant 30-year-old that trades power for poise. Verdict: a benchmark Lowland and a blue-chip collectible.
